In just the 2nd minute, Rafa Silva showcased his clinical edge, slotting the ball home with his right foot to give Benfica an early lead. The early goal set a frantic pace, leading to some heavy challenges. Leandro Barreiro received a yellow card in the 9th minute, followed by Tomas Araujo in the 24th minute after a tactical foul stopped a dangerous counter-attack. Aarhus introduced Stefen Tchamche and Rasmus Carstensen early on to find an equalizer, while Benfica responded by bringing on Jhon Duran and Andreas Schjelderup to maintain their offensive threat. The game became a battle of wits in the midfield, with fewer clear-cut chances than the opening period. Benfica navigated the final stages professionally, introducing Fredrik Aursnes and Jakub Kaminski to solidify the midfield. After five minutes of stoppage time, the referee blew the final whistle, confirming a vital victory for Benfica in their European campaign.
